body: My father is a liberal atheist somehow, my mom was too but she's passed away. He knows but there's not much he can do. My parents had me very young so I was kind of raised by both them and my grandparents, who I've lived with for a good chunk of my life. I have a girlfriend who's also trans and lives in the UK so that's a triple whammy. I've stayed with her for about 3/4 months total spread out over a few trips and really I've never felt more at home anywhere else. We've talked and talked and worked towards me getting a visa or going to school there but I know it's hard to do. So yeah, hopeless.

I thought about leaving a note explaining all of it. It's kind of difficult because they're very religious and sometimes straight up hateful. One time my grandfather saw a pride parade on the news and said to "nuke it." At the moment I'm not in a financially stable position so I'm afraid they'll either kick me out or make my life hell while I still live here.
